relationships.subject: Wnt pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results demonstrated that activation of Wnt during the lymphatic endothelial transdifferentiation of ADSCs would enhance the efficacy of VEGF-C treatment.

relationships.subject: LiCl
relationships.evidence_quote: We used LiCl to activate Wnt and DKK-1 to inhibit Wnt.

relationships.subject: DKK-1
relationships.evidence_quote: We used LiCl to activate Wnt and DKK-1 to inhibit Wnt.

key_findings: Wnt activation in VEGF-C-treated ADSCs increased lymphatic endothelial cell markers, tube length and lymphatic vessel growth in co-culture.
Wnt inhibition with DKK-1 reduced lymphatic endothelial differentiation relative to Wnt activation.
